question: In India, which Ministry issues the coins of all denominations?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Ministry of Finance.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Finance** is responsible for issuing **coins of all denominations** in India.
 
• The coins are minted by the government-owned **Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited** (SPMCIL) and its four mints located in **Mumbai, Kolkata, Hyderabad, and Noida.**
 
• The coins are issued on behalf of the **Reserve Bank of India** (RBI), which is the country's **central bank.**
 
• The coins are **legal tender** and can be used for** transactions **in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Ministry of External Affairs** is responsible for** India's foreign policy, diplomatic relations** with other countries, and** international trade and cooperation.**

 
 
• It was formed on** 2 September 1946.**
 
 
 
• The** Ministry of Home Affairs** is responsible for maintaining** internal security, law and order, disaster management**, and **border management**.
 
 
• It was formed on **15 August 1947.**
 
 
 
• The** Ministry of Mines** is responsible for the development and regulation of the mining sector, including **exploration, production, and marketing of minerals.**
 
 
• Its headquarter is in **New Delhi.**
